commit_message:
feat(company): validate the peviitor company-core model

Propagated from the Brewtality-3-16 template (commit 41cf4f9). Adds COMPANY_MODEL_FIELDS + a validator describing the shape of a peviitor company-core document, and a consistency test that fetches this scraper's live record and checks it against the model on every CI run -- so a stale or malformed record (the kind of thing that sat unnoticed for weeks in the 2026-09-24 Hochland case) gets flagged instead of silently drifting.
